SoftwareProduct.name: AwesomeApp
SoftwareProduct.description: A feature-rich application designed for seamless productivity.

issues.title: Login Failure
issues.description: Users are unable to log in due to credential verification errors.

solutions.description: Restart the authentication server and verify network connectivity.

steps.instruction: Check the network connection and verify stability.

diagnostic_tests.name: Server Connectivity Test
diagnostic_tests.description: Checks if the server is reachable.
diagnostic_tests.procedure: Ping the server and verify response time.

log_entries.message: Authentication server did not respond in time.

faqs.question: What can cause login failures?
faqs.answer: Login failures may be due to server issues or network problems. Please check connectivity.

user_feedback.comment: The solution worked, but it took too long.

issues.title: Crash on Startup
issues.description: The application crashes immediately after launch.

symptoms.description: Application closes unexpectedly without error message.

solutions.description: Reinstall the application to restore missing or corrupted files.

steps.instruction: Uninstall the current version of the application.
Download the latest installer from the official website.
Install the application and restart your computer.

diagnostic_tests.name: Installation Integrity Test
diagnostic_tests.description: Verifies the integrity of installed files.
diagnostic_tests.procedure: Run the built-in installer repair tool.

faqs.question: What should I do if the app crashes on startup?
faqs.answer: Try reinstalling the application to ensure all files are intact.

user_feedback.comment: Frequent crashes make the app unusable until reinstalled.

issues.title: Slow Performance
issues.description: The application responds slowly and exhibits lag during usage.

causes.description: High CPU usage due to memory leaks.

solutions.description: Restart the application and clear cache to resolve performance issues.

steps.instruction: Close the application and reopen it.
Clear the application cache from Settings.

diagnostic_tests.name: Performance Benchmark Test
diagnostic_tests.description: Measures CPU and memory usage during application runtime.
diagnostic_tests.procedure: Use the built-in performance monitor for 5 minutes.

faqs.question: Why is the app running slowly?
faqs.answer: High resource usage and memory leaks can cause performance degradation. Try clearing the cache or restarting.

user_feedback.comment: The app lags when multiple features are in use.

issues.title: Data Sync Error
issues.description: Data synchronization between the device and the cloud fails intermittently.

symptoms.description: Data remains outdated on the device.

causes.description: Expired authentication token or connectivity issues.

solutions.description: Reauthenticate and check internet connection to restore data synchronization.

steps.instruction: Log out and log back in to refresh authentication.
Verify internet connectivity and trigger a manual sync.

diagnostic_tests.name: Network Connectivity Test
diagnostic_tests.description: Ensures stable network connection for data sync.
diagnostic_tests.procedure: Run a ping test to the server.

log_entries.message: Data synchronization failed due to token expiry.

faqs.question: How do I fix data sync errors?
faqs.answer: Ensure your internet connection is stable and reauthenticate your account.

user_feedback.comment: Sync issues are annoying but resolved after re-login.

issues.title: Unexpected Shutdown
issues.description: The application shuts down unexpectedly during operation without any warning.

symptoms.description: The application closes suddenly and restarts.

causes.description: Hardware overheating or critical software bug.

solutions.description: Monitor hardware temperature and update the application to the latest version.

steps.instruction: Check your device's temperature using a monitoring tool.
Install any available updates for the application.

diagnostic_tests.name: Temperature Diagnostic Test
diagnostic_tests.description: Measures the hardware temperature during usage.
diagnostic_tests.procedure: Use a temperature monitoring utility for a 10-minute test.

log_entries.message: Unexpected shutdown detected during heavy load.

faqs.question: What should I do if the app shuts down unexpectedly?
faqs.answer: Monitor your device temperature and ensure you are using the latest software version.

user_feedback.comment: The unexpected shutdowns are very disruptive.

faqs.question: How do I update the software?
faqs.answer: To update the software, go to Settings > About and click 'Check for Updates'.
